about: Eight customer voices. A voice is drawn per call (the driver and dispatcher voices only for company vehicles) and fills every generic customer line; written lines take its opener, filler or tail. Lines are East and Middle Tennessee phone speech, as in the story calls. A role is a list of wordings, or {"parts": [[...], [...]]}: one piece from each part, joined by a space (an empty piece is allowed).
